title: FactorValueArchiveHandler ignores payload data_start/data_end - reads entire parquet
description: FactorValueArchiveHandler reads the full parquet file for the factor and does not narrow by payload data_start/data_end bounds. design_note (docs/architecture/factor_value_data_bounds_design_note_20260510.md) flags this as an open gap. Acceptable for current event-driven trickle, BUG before high-volume worker enable: writes can fan-out to all historic dates each event causing write-bandwidth amplification. Codex T14b/c fix round 2 review P2.1 (drawer de61c45a). Round 3 fix scheduled to add data_start/data_end filter in pd.read_parquet path + new test_factor_value_data_bounds_filter.

preconditions: parquet file contains rows outside this range

closure_requirements: T14b/c fix round 3 includes data_bounds filter
